name: Brave
description: You face danger without fear and inspire others with your courage.

name: Cunning
description: You rely on intelligence and trickery to overcome challenges.

name: Loyal
description: You stand by your allies no matter the situation.

name: Greedy
description: You are driven by wealth and the desire for more.

name: Wise
description: Your decisions are guided by knowledge and experience.

name: Impulsive
description: You act quickly, sometimes without thinking of consequences.

name: Honorable
description: You follow a strict moral code and value integrity.

name: Reckless
description: You take risks without worrying about the outcome.

name: Charming
description: Your personality easily attracts and influences others.

name: Stoic
description: You remain calm and composed in all situations.
